description.zh: Fashion Lab中的《墙 — The Walls of China》《灵 — Yi Ancestral and Nature Worship》《根 — Shackles of the Native Land》从概念、效果图、平裁与立裁推进到样版、样衣、Fitting、修版和最终成衣。
description.en: The Walls of China, Yi Ancestral and Nature Worship, and Shackles of the Native Land in Fashion Lab develop from concept, illustration, flat cutting and draping through patterns, toile, fitting, revision and final garment.

description.zh: 我在《幻 — Rapid Mind Evolution》中独立完成了从3D视觉设计、建模、场景与材质制作到动画和最终渲染的完整流程。
description.en: In Rapid Mind Evolution, I independently completed the full process from 3D visual design, modelling, scene and material creation through animation and final rendering.

description.zh: 我在GLITCH IN THE HIVE中参与并完成了导演、编剧、摄影、表演、素材管理、剪辑、调色、特效、配音与声音设计等端到端影片制作。
description.en: In GLITCH IN THE HIVE, I worked across direction, writing, cinematography, performance, media management, editing, grading, effects, voice and sound design to complete an end-to-end film production.

description.zh: 我在SonySIE合作项目中使用TouchDesigner连接声音与3D参数，构建了实时视听和交互表演系统。
description.en: In the SonySIE collaboration, I used TouchDesigner to connect sound with 3D parameters and build a real-time audiovisual and interactive performance system.

description.zh: 我在个人音乐作品中持续完成作词、作曲、编曲、音乐制作、混音和声音处理。
description.en: Across my personal music portfolio, I continue to write lyrics, compose, arrange, produce, mix and process sound.

description.zh: 我编写了RightClick，为macOS Finder补充复制路径与名称、新建常用文件、使用指定应用打开、快速打开文件夹和切换隐藏文件显示等右键菜单功能。
description.en: I built RightClick to extend macOS Finder context menus with copying paths and names, creating common file types, opening items with configured apps, opening folders quickly and toggling hidden-file visibility.

description.zh: 我长期通过GitHub调研和定制开源项目，同时持续进行网页开发、创意编程与小型工具制作。
description.en: I use GitHub continuously to research and customise open-source projects while developing websites, creative-code experiments and small utilities.

description.zh: 我在Obfuscation Identity Archive中整合了Three.js、网页问卷、AI API、GitHub自动归档和Vercel部署，形成一套自动化3D网页系统。
description.en: In Obfuscation Identity Archive, I integrated Three.js, web surveys, AI APIs, automated GitHub archiving and Vercel deployment into an automated 3D web system.

description.zh: 我在Digital Alchemy中探索了Veo 3.1所处生成式视频技术阶段的能力与限制，并把AIGC影像纳入传统调色和后期流程。
description.en: In Digital Alchemy, I explored the capabilities and limitations of generative video in the period represented by Veo 3.1 and integrated AIGC footage into conventional grading and post-production.

description.zh: 本科毕业论文使用投入产出分析核算中国纺织产业贸易隐含碳并研究其影响因素，结合了产业可持续研究、定量分析、数据处理与可视化。
description.en: My undergraduate thesis applies input–output analysis to account for embodied carbon associated with China’s textile industry trade and examine its influencing factors, combining industry sustainability research, quantitative analysis, data processing and visualisation.

description.zh: 我在浙江理工大学学习服装设计与工程，目前就读于伦敦艺术大学伦敦时装学院侧重可持续时尚的Fashion Futures专业，并曾获得皇家艺术学院MA Digital Direction offer；本科毕业论文测算和可视化了中国服装产业对外贸易隐含碳。
description.en: I studied Fashion Design and Engineering at Zhejiang Sci-Tech University and currently study Fashion Futures, with its focus on sustainable fashion, at London College of Fashion, University of the Arts London. I also received an offer for the MA Digital Direction programme at the Royal College of Art. For my undergraduate thesis, I calculated and visualised embodied carbon associated with foreign trade in the Chinese garment industry.

description.zh: 除了在中国驾驶，我还曾在挪威和希腊自驾；也曾用五天从杭州骑行到南京，组装过ITX及多台电脑，并实践过家庭服务器、STM32自动浇水、Arduino服装灯光和独立签证申请。
description.en: In addition to driving in China, I have also driven in Norway and Greece; I cycled from Hangzhou to Nanjing over five days, built ITX and other PCs, and worked with a home server, STM32 automated watering, Arduino garment lighting and independent visa applications.

description.zh: 通过Agent与MCP初始化Figma文件，由人工完成视觉设计，再由Agent读取Figma MCP进行视觉还原，使设计规范、组件结构与代码实现保持统一。
description.en: I initialise Figma files through an agent and MCP, complete the visual design manually, and then have an agent read Figma through MCP to reconstruct it, keeping design specifications, component structure and code implementation aligned.

description.zh: 通过多模态分析、Blender无界面脚本、Meshopt几何压缩、KTX2纹理和粒子效果烘焙，把约400 MB的GLB资产优化并拆分为总体积约15 MB的多个模型文件，在Three.js中同步加载。
description.en: Using multimodal analysis, headless Blender scripts, Meshopt geometry compression, KTX2 textures and baked particle effects, I optimised and split roughly 400 MB of GLB assets into multiple models totalling about 15 MB for concurrent loading in Three.js.

description.zh: 在大型商业网页平台中使用Agent loop与browser-use持续执行功能开发和浏览器验证，覆盖前端、后端、Supabase数据库，以及GitHub和Vercel协同的部署流程。
description.en: For a large commercial web platform, I used an agent loop and browser-use for continuous feature development and browser-based validation across the frontend, backend, Supabase database, and deployment through GitHub and Vercel.

description.zh: 通过Agent初始化并管理VPS，部署Hysteria 2节点和订阅链接，并使用Tailscale连接家庭设备，在住宅IP与服务器IP出口之间切换。
description.en: I used an agent to initialise and manage a VPS, deploy a Hysteria 2 node and subscription link, and connect home devices through Tailscale to switch between residential and server egress IPs.

description.zh: 在VPS上部署艺术装置后端AI服务，通过Playwright和Chrome内核远程登录，在公开或已获授权的范围内采集Instagram图片，连接视觉分析与AIGC模型，并在约40秒内把结果输出到ESP32。
description.en: I deployed an AI backend for an art installation on a VPS, using Playwright and Chromium for remote authenticated access and collecting public or authorised Instagram images before connecting visual analysis and AIGC models and delivering results to an ESP32 in about 40 seconds.
